raw_segments.text: And if thus we respect God,
can we give credit to the mysterious insinuations which insult His laws?
Can we believe, though it should stare us in the face,
that He would work a miracle to authorize confusion by sanctioning an error?
Yet we must either allow these impious conclusions
or treat with contempt every promise to restore health to a diseased body
or to foretell the incidents that can only be foreseen by God.
